900.3.10(1142).explanation: Site-specific RD exception 1142: buildings are set back 22.0 m from the original centreline of Lawson Rd., Colonel Danforth Trail, Meadowvale Rd., Centennial Rd. or Pickering Town Line where the front lot line abuts one of them, and 6.0 m from the front lot line otherwise; at least 0.9 m from a side lot line and 4.5 m from any lot line abutting a street. The lands must also comply with exception 900.3.10(1462), and townhouses and apartment buildings are not permitted on lots abutting Meadowvale Road.

900.3.10(88).explanation: Site-specific RD exception 88: for a detached house, the minimum lot frontage and lot area are whatever the lot had when By-law 569-2013 was enacted; buildings are set back 22.0 m from the original centreline of Bellamy Rd., 1.2 m from a side lot line and 5.7 m from a side lot line abutting a street; garages must be at least 0.3 m from a side lot line. On named Pandora Circle and Sedgmount Dr. lots a semi-detached house is permitted with at least 18.0 m of frontage (9.0 m per unit) if it meets all RD zone requirements.

900.3.10(142).explanation: Site-specific RD exception 142: the minimum lot frontage and lot area are whatever the lot had when By-law 569-2013 was enacted; buildings are set back 22.0 m from the original centreline of Birchmount Rd. and 24.0 m from the original centreline of Kennedy Rd. on lots abutting those roads, at least 0.9 m from a side lot line, and 3.6 m from a side lot line abutting a street.
